Nora L.: Spinning up POC for LedgerX. Need streaming SDK -> function/tool calling to attach FX rates as structured JSON per txn. Env: VPC + SAML SSO, 30d retention. Main asks: 1) tiny Node sample for streaming + function_call, 2) clarify how function payloads appear in SDK events, 3) hosted vs reserved pricing for ~1M tokens/mo with 500 qps peaks. Timeline: 3w.

Kaito M.: Quick: function_call events show up as discrete SDK events (type:function_call) and payload is a JSON string when you declare parameters schema. Node snippet (minimal):
```js
const s = client.responses.stream({model:'redwood-infer-pro-v1',stream:true,functions:[{name:'fx_lookup',parameters:{type:'object',properties:{pair:{type:'string'},rate:{type:'number'},ttl:{type:'integer'}},required:['pair','rate']}}],function_call:'auto'});
for await (const evt of s) { if (evt.type === 'function_call') { const tool = JSON.parse(evt.payload); /* use tool.rate */ } if (evt.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(evt.chunk); }
```

Ava S.: Pricing sketch: hosted on-demand ~ $0.02/1k tokens -> ~ $20/mo for 1M. For sustained 500 qps peaks recommend Dedicated/reserved; ballpark starting commit $8k-$10k/mo depending on model and p95 SLA. HSM on Private adds uplift. Expedited 2-week onboarding one-time fee extra.

Nora L.: Customer requires HSM if possible and will allow outbound egress with IP allowlist. They want fallback behavior documented in case reserved pool saturates.

Kaito M.: Routing policy supports prefer:dedi and fallback:hosted. Fallback keeps function_call plumbing but watch KMS differences (hosted uses RW-managed keys unless BYOK). Recommend a short parity eval between reserved and hosted model variants to catch tokenization/schema diffs. Example YAML (pseudo):
routes:
 - name: ledgerx-dedicated
   prefer: dedicated
   match: customer_id == "ledgerx"
 - name: ledgerx-hosted-fallback
   prefer: hosted
   fallback: true

SecBot: Uploaded security packet and SAML attribute map template. IP allowlist template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/ip-allowlist-template.md

Ava S.: Action items: 1) I'll produce hosted vs 3mo reserved quote + expedited onboarding line. 2) @Kaito please prep a 10min demo with Node snippet and a tiny canary that simulates 500 qps for 60s to show fallback behavior. 3) @Nora request IDP metadata, KMS/HSM confirmation, and egress CIDRs from customer (48h).

Nora L.: Sending kickoff email now with ask-list and the Node sample. Will update thread with responses. :thumbsup:
